verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents two of the three parts of this story. Breadcrumbs come through its telemetry timeline in rollbar.js and through Apple Unified Logging telemetry capture, and user context comes through person tracking of affected users, which is automatic in Rails and Django. The pack has no evidence for attaching custom tags or arbitrary key-value context to events. missing for 10: documented custom tags/custom data attachment, breadcrumb support shown beyond client-side JS and Apple AUL, detail on how person context is set in other SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
